verdict.rationale: Release changelogs are a fair question for a project-tracking tool, but the evidence documents no changelog or release-notes generation in GitHub Projects. Only adjacent features appear: Markdown status updates, built-in field workflows, and GraphQL API/Actions building blocks a developer could use to build one. None of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
